name: fpdt
author: FPDT
description: Stores and restores Flashpoint's non-portable save data inside the Flashpoint folder, with per-account profiles, a shared system partition, and optional scoped Google Drive cloud sync.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/sync.test.js test/extension.test.js test/cloud.test.js test/manifest-store.test.js

fpdt.openManager.title: Save Data Manager
fpdt.openManager.description: Sync now, copy a profile, deploy a profile to this machine, or delete a profile.

fpdt.profile.title: Active Profile
fpdt.profile.description: Profile name to sync with. Empty uses the current Windows account name.

fpdt.syncOnStartup.title: Restore On Launcher Startup
fpdt.syncOnStartup.description: Run a full two-way sync as soon as the launcher starts.

fpdt.restoreBeforeLaunch.title: Restore Before Game Launch
fpdt.restoreBeforeLaunch.description: Sync save data before a game or add app is launched, so restored data is in place before it is used.

fpdt.backupOnFileChange.title: Backup While Playing
fpdt.backupOnFileChange.description: Watch the save data folders and back up changes shortly after they are written (this is how backups are captured when a game closes).

fpdt.backupIntervalMinutes.title: Backup Interval (minutes)
fpdt.backupIntervalMinutes.description: Safety backup of local changes at this interval. Set to 0 to disable.

fpdt.conflictPolicy.title: Conflict Resolution
fpdt.conflictPolicy.description: What wins when both the Flashpoint copy and this machine changed the same file. "newest" compares modification times; ties go to the Flashpoint copy.

fpdt.safetyBackups.title: Keep Conflict Copies
fpdt.safetyBackups.description: Copy the losing version of a conflict into the profile's .conflicts folder instead of discarding it.

fpdt.cloudSync.title: Enable Cloud Sync
fpdt.cloudSync.description: Back up the Flashpoint folder to Google Drive and restore it on other machines. Uses only the hidden app data folder, so other Drive files are never touched.

fpdt.cloudSyncOnChange.title: Cloud Sync After Local Changes
fpdt.cloudSyncOnChange.description: After save data is backed up into the Flashpoint folder, also upload the change to Google Drive.

fpdt.cloudIntervalMinutes.title: Cloud Sync Interval (minutes)
fpdt.cloudIntervalMinutes.description: How often to check Google Drive for changes. Set to 0 to disable the periodic check; watcher, startup, pre-launch and manual syncs still run.

fpdt.cloudClientId.title: Google Drive Client ID
fpdt.cloudClientId.description: OAuth client ID from a Google Cloud project with the Drive API enabled and a Desktop app OAuth client.

fpdt.cloudClientSecret.title: Google Drive Client Secret
fpdt.cloudClientSecret.description: Client secret for the same Desktop app OAuth client. Cloud sync stays optional and off until enabled.
